name: codex-antigravity-router
description: Delegate coherent engineering work to Antigravity through isolated managed Git worktrees with independent verification and guarded integration.

interface.longDescription: Codex retains architecture and risk decisions while Antigravity investigates, implements, tests, and repairs scoped tasks in isolated worktrees. Users configure their preferred model and worker ceiling; Codex chooses how many independent tasks to run up to that ceiling.
